_comment: ONE KiCad MCP: Konnect (mixelpixx/Konnect v0.11.1), a single Rust binary at
D:/tools/konnect. It covers both modes, which is why it is the only one:
KiCad OPEN    talks to it over the official IPC API. Edits go through
KiCad, so KiCad stays the only writer and every change lands
in its undo stack (BeginCommit/EndCommit).
KiCad CLOSED  reads and writes the files with its own S-expression engine.
Verified 2026-09-14 with no KiCad running: get_pin_connections
still returned R1.1 -> TC1_RAW_P (28.19, 19.0).
226 tools in 21 toolsets, loaded on demand - list_toolboxes, then
load_toolset. Argument is 'schematic', not 'path'.
KICAD_API_SOCKET IS NOT OPTIONAL ON WINDOWS. Konnect issue #529: NNG makes
an ipc:// endpoint a NAMED PIPE, not a file. Verified here 2026-09-13 - the
pipe name is the path string under the pipe namespace while NO FILE exists
at that path. Auto-detection therefore fails, and a client that concludes
KiCad is not running falls back to editing the file - with KiCad holding it
open. That is the 2026-09-07 board loss, recreated. Setting this variable is
what prevents it. Confirm with open_project ('ipc_available') before writing
while KiCad is open.
KiCad's API server must stay enabled: kicad_common.json -> api.enable_server
= true. Turned on 2026-09-13; backup at kicad_common.json.bak-20260913.
RETIRED 2026-09-14: Seeed-Studio/kicad-mcp-server. Its write tools appended
text with no parser (docs/decisions/0012) and its reads are covered by
Konnect and by the `kicad` skill's analysers. See 0013.
Also registered at user scope in ~/.claude.json and in ~/.codex/config.toml,
so both agents find Konnect in any project. This project file is kept anyway
and is the one that matters: it travels with the repo, so a teammate who
clones thermo gets the server AND the socket warning above without having to
set anything up. The two definitions are identical.
